title: Need help working what's wrong with my Game
author: DOTR-Online
selftext:
Hi All,

Ive spent about 200 hours working on an AI assisted stratergy card/boars hybrid game.

Its not your classic high graphics game and the core loop is on resource collection.

Each round is broken into 2 phases, the first being all players (humand/ai) vote simultaneously with the winning timeline being the active event for the round. The second phase is the players choosing an action. Once again the players and AI all submit their action without knowing what others players are doing. Then all actions resolve, end of round bonuses apply and the next round begins.

I've tried to streamline the onboarsing and tutorials as much as I can but from my game logs, I'm losing people at the first round.

Can some of you fine gentlemen have a look at my game and give me thoughts on how to improve this.

Its browser-based and optimized for pc, tabet and smartphone.

Link https://dotronline.com 

Thank you for your time.

Jason

comments.author: king-krool
comments.body: I’d say it was very frustrating to play on phone. You seem to be designing for an app layout but on providing a web link. It asks me to rotate but doesn’t display well at all. It doesn’t account for the screen bevel. You need to have a tutorial of some kind with this ui heavy layout. You need visual hierarchy. I can’t tell what I’m supposed to press next.

replies.author: DOTR-Online
replies.body:
Thanks for your insight. Ive tried it on 2 different phones and fits well but I can do better. If you can post an image of what yours looks like it will help.

For the tutorial,  I had more explainer text but thought it was overloading people.

There is a press me for Recruit, do you think having the same thing for deploy and challlenge would help?

Your suggestion has made me think the platforms I'm listing on it may be the issue as it does play better on pc and tablet so possibility I need to try to get it listed on more pc based sites.
